reading_notes: Systemic issue: across nearly every line, the vendor's PKG-code labels in the pricing table do not match the dimensions/ply/print spec of the same-numbered RFX line. Several vendor lines have dimensions that exactly match a *different* RFX code's spec (e.g. vendor's PKG-004 = RFX PKG-003 dims; PKG-006 = RFX PKG-005; PKG-013 = RFX PKG-015; PKG-016 = RFX PKG-017; PKG-020 = RFX PKG-022; PKG-023 = RFX PKG-027), suggesting the vendor's numbering/catalog does not correspond 1:1 to this RFQ's line items. Quoted monthly quantities also differ substantially from RFQ qty_per_month on every quoted line (typically 1.5x-7x higher). 8 of 30 RFX lines (PKG-005, 015, 021, 024, 026, 028, 029, 030) are not quoted at all, with no stated reason. Two internal conflicts found: recycled content is stated as 32% in the questionnaire but 18% in the attached materials declaration; and the questionnaire claims the ISO certificate is 'in force for the full contract period' while the attached certificate shows validity ending 14 March 2026, before the quotation's own date of 21 August 2026. Recommend the buyer request a corrected quotation mapped explicitly to the RFQ's PKG-001 through PKG-030 codes and quantities before this response is used for scoring.
